snippet.title: IRONWAKE - Official Announcement Teaser #1
snippet.description:
Official gameplay trailer for IRONWAKE, a single session, linear, psychological horror game wherein the player uploads his or her consciousness into an old Soviet robot locked in a dead bunker.

Hide in the dark, solve puzzles in dying machines and listen to the radio guiding you. Find clues and change the outcome of the story.

 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4858340/IRONWAKE/

Game features: 

Linear immersive story

Unique vision as a robot in a dead Soviet bunker

Stealth mechanics and environmental puzzles

Multiple endings depending on your choices and findings

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Audio & Music:
𝕊𝕠𝕗𝕠𝕔 𝕄𝕦𝕤𝕚𝕔 - https://www.youtube.com/@SofocMusic/videos
